grades.quote: `SC.Q` instruction will check LLbit when executing, and only when LLbit is 1, then it will write, otherwise it will not write
grades.reason: This LoongArch SC.Q passage gives part of the diagnosis. The store succeeds only if LLbit is 1, and otherwise it doesn't write and returns a failure flag in rd. It also says a non-cacheable access attribute makes the result indeterminate, and a non-16-byte-aligned address raises an exception. These are plausible causes of repeated failure. The passage doesn't explain what clears LLbit or give a full troubleshooting procedure.
